newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli industrial production growth slows.
newsitem.headline: Israeli industrial production growth slows.

text.p: Israeli industrial production growth slowed last year to 5.5 percent after rising 8.5 percent in 1995, the Central Bureau of Statistics said on Wednesday.
It said the main area of growth was in electronic components and jewellery but food and beverage production was static and the manufacture of footware and clothing declined.

Releasing the annual figure, the bureau gave no statistics for December but said industrial production rose 0.4 percent in November compared with increases of 0.3 percent in October and 0.5 percent in November 1995.
Earlier on Wednesday, Bank Leumi said in a report that Israel's gross domestic product would expand 3.9 percent this year, slowing from an estimated 4.4 percent in 1996.
